archetypes.name: teardown-safety
archetypes.rationale: Ancestor skip regressions protect active teardown callers from accidental signals.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the finalizer cleanup tests and implementation for PID-chain correctness. Check that live ancestor collection remains primary and the transient shell probe is only supplemental. Verify stale session processes are still terminated while active teardown ancestry is skipped Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
